Mathcad

Mathcad provides engineering calculation worksheets with units, notation and documented results.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build a unit-aware calculation

Begin with the selected equations, data, parameters and units. In the intended Mathcad preview, build a unit-aware calculation; the visible result is a reproducible model or calculation with declared inputs visible. Review dimensions, assumptions, data quality and numerical range before accepting or exporting it.

Evaluate a design case

Use the operating case, solver settings or experiment space. In the intended Mathcad preview, evaluate a design case; the visible result is computed signals, candidates or numerical results linked to each parameter. Review stability, convergence, sensitivity and expected behaviour before accepting or exporting it.

Publish a checked worksheet

Start from the checked plots, tables and requirement references. In the intended Mathcad preview, publish a checked worksheet; the visible result is a reviewable notebook, worksheet or result package. Review units, reproducibility, traceability and engineering interpretation before accepting or exporting it.
